# Vendored SDL3-UWP

Imported from guimaraf/3sxw PR #2, authored by caorthann-celt:
https://github.com/guimaraf/3sxw/pull/2
Snapshot: 0234222967e1b41a37316c9c8cf2146252301672

The upstream repository, revision and license are recorded in manifest.json.
This is the PR author's patched snapshot, not a claim of an unmodified upstream checkout.
SDL3 sources are ordinary tracked files; building SDL does not fetch that repository.
Preserve SDL3/LICENSE.txt and copyright notices when updating the copy.
FFmpeg, mbedTLS and zlib are still restored through vcpkg; they are not vendored here.
